notes: kb/Work PB5815 LANDED (wave 20262068, 2026-11-16): the PARTIAL of the 1985 code reads (kb/Work/PB5683/2026-11-15-rulings-code-reads-batch-6.md, cause b, every edition) is fixed: FileConnector.Open asks the organization's SupportsReadOperations once above the organizations, and SequentialConnector answers no for a record sequential print file (LINAGE, or an ADVANCING WRITE declared or executed), so OPEN INPUT and OPEN I-O are 37 (§2023:9.1.13.6 GR6a.3, GR6a.2; docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-146 (c')) instead of reading print controls as records; witness pb5815_print_file_not_read_back (accept 2002, 2014, 2023; MATCH at --std 2002 and 2023 on the merged build) and its 1985 twin. || Rule has three parts (cite.py --check 12.4.5.5.3 OK for 2) a), 2) b), 2) c)). All three verified by probe at --std 85 and 2023: a) sequential file written S2,S1 then OPEN EXTEND S0 reads back S2,S1,S0 -- predecessor-successor order of the WRITEs at creation and extension (gB.cob); b) relative file written RANDOM at RRN 5,2,9 reads back sequentially R2,R5,R9 -- ascending RRN of existing records, gaps skipped (gB.cob); c) indexed file written DYNAMIC C1,A3,B2 reads back sequentially A3,B2,C1 on the prime key, and after START on the alternate key C1,B2,A3 -- ascending within the key of reference (gA.cob); the collating-sequence half of c) is covered by conformance:cases/12.4.5.7-COLLATING-SEQUENCE/pb703_collating_key_named_twice and conformance:cases/12.4.5.7-COLLATING-SEQUENCE/file_collating_seq (both derive expected output from §12.4.5.5.3 GR2 c) and §12.4.5.7.4), IndexedConnector.cs:755 cites GR2c. test-ref left empty because no single spec-derived golden covers a) and b) as well as c). [registrar 14a — editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023 (Annex E lists no substantive change to the ACCESS MODE clause)] EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED 2026-11-10: in force at 85, §1985:VII.2.4.3 GR2 'For sequential files this sequence is specified by predecessor-successor record relationships established by the execution of WRITE statements when the file is created or extended', §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR2 'For relative files this sequence is the order of ascending relative record numbers of existing records in the file' and §1985:IX.2.4.4 GR2 'For indexed files this sequence is ascending within a given key of reference according to the collating sequence of the file'.
